order_appended.meaning: a new order has been appended to the doubly linked list for the price level

non_head_order_present.meaning: a non-head order exists in the price-level list

open_interest_counter.meaning: value of the open-interest counter (numBids/numAsks) for the price level

reachable_order_count.meaning: number of orders actually addressable via the limit's headOrder/tailOrder chain

assumptions: The corruption persists because every operation is wrapped in a successful transaction.
The open-interest counter is the numBids/numAsks counter for the affected price level.
Reachable orders are those addressable via the limit's headOrder/tailOrder chain.

unresolved.description: Report gives no numeric values or formula for how open-interest is inflated/deflated; the counter is bound symbolically to the reachable-order count.

limitations: Only the open_interest_misstated impact is formalized; orphaning, traversal invisibility and MAX_UINT sentinel outcomes are not covered by this claim.
The correspondence is stated at the counter level; per-order identity of counted entries is not encoded.
